empty_space.where: The bottom of the left and right columns, leaving 16% of the canvas blank and creating an unbalanced, bottom-heavy appearance in the center.

small_visual_text.where: The text, numbers, and labels in Tables 1, 2, and 4, as well as the axes and legends in Figures 3 and 4, are too small to be legible from a normal viewing distance.

dense_text.where: Most sections, including Motivation, Evaluation Setup, Core Contributions, Progressive Grounding, and Implications, feature long, unbroken paragraphs of small body text.

layout.reason: The layout follows a clear three-column structure but is unbalanced, leaving 16% of the canvas empty at the bottom of the outer columns while the center column extends to the bottom.

readability.reason: Readability is compromised by extremely dense text blocks across all sections and very small font sizes in the tables and figure axes.

fidelity.reason: The poster accurately and comprehensively presents the CLASVS architecture, its core routing and grounding mechanisms, and its performance results using the key figures and tables from the paper.

holistic.reason: The poster is highly faithful to the source paper, but its effectiveness is reduced by extremely dense text blocks and tiny figure labels, alongside an unbalanced layout that leaves the bottom corners empty.
